title: Simpul Benang Tetangga
theme: Seorang pensiunan yang gemar mengamati menemukan kehangatan dan koneksi tak terduga di balik misteri kecil di lingkungan apartemennya.

cover.prompt: A tranquil, close-up view from a peaceful balcony during golden hour. Gentle, warm sunlight softly illuminates vibrant green and orange leaves on a distant mango tree, creating a soft-focus backdrop. In the foreground, a delicate, blurred hint of small birds perched on a railing, suggesting quiet observation. The composition emphasizes natural details and an inviting atmosphere, with a strong sense of depth. Cinematic composition, rule of thirds, shallow depth of field.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Bu Ratna, a retired observer, discovers strange items at her neighbor Anya's door. Her curiosity leads her to uncover Anya's struggle with an art project. Bu Ratna offers help, fostering an unexpected friendship and community connection through their collaboration on the art installation.
